text:
GENERATE BURST CS-objiso-cow — ISOLATE the dead-cow carcass from its painted crop (R-C3-95). task_id "CS-objiso-cow".

IMAGE 1 (1536×1024) is a sheet on flat PURE GREEN #00ff00 with one enlarged tile cropped from a hand-painted 2D ARPG level: a dead cow lying on its side on dirt and grass, slightly burnt, with a flayed stomach, and its contact shadow.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536×1024 image in which ONLY the COW stays EXACTLY as painted (same pixels, position, size, outline, colours, wound and burnt patches) and everything else — dirt, grass, pebbles, tufts and the cast/contact shadow — becomes flat PURE GREEN #00ff00 with a crisp edge (no halo, glow or blur). Where grass overlapped the cow's outline, finish the cow's edge cleanly. Nothing new is added; nothing moves.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if the cow moved or changed, ground/shadow remains attached, or the green is not flat — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/objiso_cow.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-objiso-cow"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
